title: Fast RCA Scorer and Mini-Playbook Preloader
author: Nina R. Patel
release_notes: Adds a probabilistic RCA scorer and a mini-playbook preloader to reduce mean time to first action; safe rollout behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: Incident responders spend most of the first critical minutes collecting hypotheses from disparate artifacts (traces, metrics, deploys). This PR introduces a lightweight, deterministic-first RCA Scorer plus a Mini-Playbook Preloader that surfaces the top N hypotheses and cached playbook fragments as ephemeral responder cards. Goals: reduce time-to-first-action (TTFA), make early hypotheses explicit, and prefetch the smallest actionable runbook fragments without changing existing runbook storage or ownership. Change summary: - rca/scorer: new fast scorer that combines anomaly signals, recent deploy metadata, and span-level error fingerprints into a ranked hypothesis list with confidence scores. Uses heuristics + a tiny feature table (no heavy ML model) to keep latency < 50ms. - runner/preloader: before responder acknowledgment, preloads top-3 playbook snippets (steps 1-3) and sanitizes any secrets via existing scrubber. Prefetches only small fragments to avoid overhead. - api: new ephemeral endpoint /v1/incident-mini-playbook that incident-bot UI and CLI can call; guarded by feature flag incident.mini_playbook.preload. - telemetry: adds rca.hypothesis.latency, rca.hypothesis.count, preloader.cache_hit, preloader.bytes_fetched metrics and a tracing span with deterministic sampling. - feature flag + rollout: default off for all customers; enabled for internal SRE via feature flag config and opt-in via /admin. Checklist: [x] unit tests for scorer heuristics [x] integration test for preloader happy path [x] e2e smoke CLI test [x] feature flag gating [x] added dashboards and alerting for increased preloader traffic What I changed (high level): - rca/scorer.py (new): implements scoring pipeline and JSON schema for hypothesis objects - runner/preloader.go (new): lightweight Go preloader used by the bot worker - api/mini_playbook_handler.py: new HTTP handler that returns cached fragments or triggers a background fetch - ui/cards/mini_playbook_card.tsx: new ephemeral card used in responder UI - tests/*: new unit and integration tests - infra/feature_flags.yaml: added incident.mini_playbook.preload Rollout plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag (this PR) 2) Enable internally for SRE team for 48h smoke 3) Ramp to 10% of incidents for low-risk services and observe metrics for increased latency or cache thrash 4) Open to wider customers after 2 weeks of stable telemetry Monitoring and SLOs added: - alert if preloader.latency > 200ms p95 for 5m - alert if hypothesis.count exceeds 10 (regression check) - dashboard: new 'Mini-Playbook Preloader' dashboard linked in release notes Backwards compatibility: API is additive and guarded by a feature flag; existing runbooks remain unchanged Security & privacy: preloader sanitizes text via the existing scrubber; no payloads are persisted beyond ephemeral cache TTL (30s). Known limitations & future work: - current scorer is heuristic-based and can be tuned; follow-up task ENG-9043 to add lightweight learned weights - preloader currently only fetches first 3 steps; we may expand prefetch heuristics later Testing notes: integration tests mock trace/metrics sources and exercise the full request->score->preload path. Load test simulating 2000 incidents/hour shows median preloader latency 28ms, 99p 98ms. Related work: ENG-8421 (on-call ergonomics), ENG-9043 (RCA tuning). Manual QA instructions and screenshots uploaded to the Linear ticket.
